Combining Allegra (fexofenadine) with alcohol is ` [Highlight start] generally discouraged [Highlight end] ` , as mixing them can increase drowsiness, dizziness, and impaired coordination.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1_xaAwFM7kGlPRfLZVfYKS71YkdtQ5NxqHqCt4nNIBubE9pl_LmJPWCrymFeV9jTZ-8mCZM5raLbREw1hkIyhLDUhGKjlDY4mTWHWd0vTl2FhLdWyVk9ZJhD1bjmmV7NIsd1IRI2IOZDQKPVMlAdX-iLpLnQcXPqOfPbGwE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXbz_Hp1gdCLQbeN9kAPasTzBN_MQVgRO-K6UUVowTIuSBCs7ZOkT93Ur41WI0D3c7ykM-KHRDctcqRvdRHy131Is-BQbDkIrWZZRSVl9IxRtiUoWF8SArPU5Bm_rpph44Eg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF119AVmw_PmMQW3JLebqqGsFUWprKnmK81dvrRjLvZ89zUQl9H2QI-ONFUIweZi7GF09r-ojF1bcGwfuYx0VmqJMoc0Vz4vLVSphwOeAoEy6wDMjLNeUpfPIZvVBzFF1ZLjx0JGVjaDkgjLGzXsSMpYIZjiBGGRxBo7CfQrjp0EdMREwrld0CK9_dThm5vNrmQvVJZO_ZPQ)

Although Allegra is a second-generation antihistamine that typically causes little to no sleepiness on its own, pairing it with alcohol can still lead to unexpected sedation—especially with heavier drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXbz_Hp1gdCLQbeN9kAPasTzBN_MQVgRO-K6UUVowTIuSBCs7ZOkT93Ur41WI0D3c7ykM-KHRDctcqRvdRHy131Is-BQbDkIrWZZRSVl9IxRtiUoWF8SArPU5Bm_rpph44Eg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1_xaAwFM7kGlPRfLZVfYKS71YkdtQ5NxqHqCt4nNIBubE9pl_LmJPWCrymFeV9jTZ-8mCZM5raLbREw1hkIyhLDUhGKjlDY4mTWHWd0vTl2FhLdWyVk9ZJhD1bjmmV7NIsd1IRI2IOZDQKPVMlAdX-iLpLnQcXPqOfPbGwE)

### Key Precautions

- **Watch for additive impairment:** Alcohol slows the central nervous system, which can intensify mild side effects like fatigue, poor balance, or slowed reflexes. Avoid driving or operating machinery if you combine them.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF119AVmw_PmMQW3JLebqqGsFUWprKnmK81dvrRjLvZ89zUQl9H2QI-ONFUIweZi7GF09r-ojF1bcGwfuYx0VmqJMoc0Vz4vLVSphwOeAoEy6wDMjLNeUpfPIZvVBzFF1ZLjx0JGVjaDkgjLGzXsSMpYIZjiBGGRxBo7CfQrjp0EdMREwrld0CK9_dThm5vNrmQvVJZO_ZPQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXbz_Hp1gdCLQbeN9kAPasTzBN_MQVgRO-K6UUVowTIuSBCs7ZOkT93Ur41WI0D3c7ykM-KHRDctcqRvdRHy131Is-BQbDkIrWZZRSVl9IxRtiUoWF8SArPU5Bm_rpph44Eg)
- **Limit amounts if you drink:** Healthcare sources generally advise avoiding alcohol while taking allergy medications, or keeping intake strictly moderate (typically up to 1 drink per day for women and 2 drinks per day for men) after checking with a doctor or pharmacist.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1_xaAwFM7kGlPRfLZVfYKS71YkdtQ5NxqHqCt4nNIBubE9pl_LmJPWCrymFeV9jTZ-8mCZM5raLbREw1hkIyhLDUhGKjlDY4mTWHWd0vTl2FhLdWyVk9ZJhD1bjmmV7NIsd1IRI2IOZDQKPVMlAdX-iLpLnQcXPqOfPbGwE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXbz_Hp1gdCLQbeN9kAPasTzBN_MQVgRO-K6UUVowTIuSBCs7ZOkT93Ur41WI0D3c7ykM-KHRDctcqRvdRHy131Is-BQbDkIrWZZRSVl9IxRtiUoWF8SArPU5Bm_rpph44Eg)
- **Check combination cold/flu meds:** Avoid pairing Allegra with multi-symptom cold remedies that already contain sedating antihistamines or high doses of acetaminophen if you drink regularly.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXbz_Hp1gdCLQbeN9kAPasTzBN_MQVgRO-K6UUVowTIuSBCs7ZOkT93Ur41WI0D3c7ykM-KHRDctcqRvdRHy131Is-BQbDkIrWZZRSVl9IxRtiUoWF8SArPU5Bm_rpph44Eg)
- **Consider higher-risk groups:** Older adults, people with liver or kidney issues, and those taking sedatives, sleep aids, or mental health medications face a higher chance of stronger side effects.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1_xaAwFM7kGlPRfLZVfYKS71YkdtQ5NxqHqCt4nNIBubE9pl_LmJPWCrymFeV9jTZ-8mCZM5raLbREw1hkIyhLDUhGKjlDY4mTWHWd0vTl2FhLdWyVk9ZJhD1bjmmV7NIsd1IRI2IOZDQKPVMlAdX-iLpLnQcXPqOfPbGwE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXbz_Hp1gdCLQbeN9kAPasTzBN_MQVgRO-K6UUVowTIuSBCs7ZOkT93Ur41WI0D3c7ykM-KHRDctcqRvdRHy131Is-BQbDkIrWZZRSVl9IxRtiUoWF8SArPU5Bm_rpph44Eg)
